ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
fun isStartDateOfMonth(date: Date) = date.day == 1
fun getPreviousMonthLastDate(date: Date) = (date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-01"} as Date) - |P1D|
fun getCurrentMonthStartDate(date: Date) = date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-01"} as Date
fun getDaysInMonth(date: Date) = ((date as String {format: "yyyy-MM-01"} as Date) + |P1M| - |P1D|).day
var inputDate = vars.inventoryDate var parsedDate = inputDate as Date {format: "d-MMM-yyyy"} var previousMonthLastDate = getPreviousMonthLastDate(parsedDate) var currentMonthStartDate = getCurrentMonthStartDate(parsedDate) var daysInMonth = getDaysInMonth(parsedDate)
--- { "originalDate": parsedDate, "isStartDateOfMonth": isStartDateOfMonth(parsedDate), "daysInMonth": daysInMonth, "previousMonthLastDate": previousMonthLastDate as String {format: "d-MMM-yy"}, "StartDate": currentMonthStartDate as String {format: "d-MMM-yy"}, "date": parsedDate as String {format: "M/d/yy"}, "monthYear": parsedDate as String {format: "MMM"}, "weekday": parsedDate as String {format: "EEEE"}, "year": parsedDate as String {format: "yyyy"} }
